valid_measurements.render_follows_page_frame_rate: In every run where the page rAF rate was stable, each companion rendered exactly one frame per page frame (fps == page rAF Hz): 29.5 = 29.5 and 30.2 = 30.2 (dashboard, 2 canvases), 29.8 = 29.8 (full view), 15 = 15 (dashboard) while the host throttled the pane.

not_verified_on_gpu.dashboard_two_companions_at_60hz: Not verified. During the dashboard runs the host app throttled the pane (page rAF 15-30 Hz, timers throttled) because the app window was not in the foreground. One early run showed 31.2 / 15.7 fps at a 60 Hz page rAF and a later one 37 / 37; neither could be reproduced under stable conditions. No 60 fps claim is made for two simultaneous canvases.
not_verified_on_gpu.pointer_overhead_on_gpu: Not measured: page timers were throttled (5 synthetic pointer events in 4 s). Raycast cost was measured in headless Chrome instead (0.04 ms avg, CPU-bound, not GPU-dependent).
not_verified_on_gpu.mobile: No real mobile device available: mobile performance remains unverified.
